items.summary_en: Railse routes approval prompts from Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI through one local daemon and a single rule set: read-only and in-project edits pass automatically, network and irreversible commands always ask, and anything the rules can't classify is pushed to your phone via Web Push. Approvals can be saved as rules, except outbound and irreversible ones. If the daemon is unreachable for 30 seconds, the CLIs fall back to their own prompts. v0.1.2, Apache 2.0.

items.title: [硬件] RAID 换盘为什么要一块一块来：连换三块盘把阵列弄异常了，顺便说说重建期间要盯什么
items.summary_zh: 一位客户连续换下三块硬盘，RAID 状态随即异常，作者借此梳理基本原则：RAID 5 只容忍一块盘离线、RAID 6 两块，新盘要等重建 100% 完成、状态回到 Optimal 才算好盘，此时再拔一块就会超出容错。文中还列了重建期间该盯的进度、其他盘的 media error 和控制器日志里的 foreign config，以及同料号兼容盘、点灯确认槽位、别随手 initialize 这些坑。
items.summary_en: A customer's array went abnormal after three drives were swapped back to back, prompting a write-up of the basics: RAID 5 tolerates one offline drive and RAID 6 two, and a replacement doesn't count as healthy until its rebuild finishes and status returns to Optimal — pulling the next drive before that exceeds fault tolerance. The post also covers what to watch during rebuild and common mistakes like incompatible drive models and slot mix-ups.

items.title: [Apple] M6 vs M4 Pro, M6 确实有意思

items.summary_en: A Mac mini with M6 (12+12 cores, 32GB) was compared against one with M4 Pro (14+20 cores, 64GB): Geekbench single-core 4000 vs 3400, multi-core 22000 vs 25800, Metal 90000 vs 115000, with everyday use feeling identical. The real gap shows in Lightroom 15.6 noise reduction running on the NPU, where 20 45MP RAWs took 2m28s on M6 versus 5m12s on M4 Pro. The author concludes M6 makes the base M4 Pro hard to justify.

items.title: Cloudflare 的 OHTTP 网关拒绝解密通过 Cloudflare 传入的请求
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 为 OHTTP Gateway 开启封闭测试，这是一个替源站解密 Oblivious HTTP（RFC 9458）请求的托管端点。它明确拒绝解密来自 Cloudflare Workers 或经 Cloudflare 代理主机的请求，因为负责识别的中继跳点和负责解密的网关跳点必须由互不相关的运营方持有。中继服务器需用户自备，原 Privacy Gateway 更名为 OHTTP Relay。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare has opened a closed beta of its OHTTP Gateway, a hosted endpoint that decrypts Oblivious HTTP (RFC 9458) requests on behalf of origin servers. The notable constraint: it refuses to decrypt traffic arriving through Cloudflare Workers or proxied hosts, since the relay hop that sees client IPs and the decrypting hop must be run by unrelated operators. Cloudflare ships no relay server; its older Privacy Gateway is now called OHTTP Relay.

items.summary_en: QCon Shanghai 2026, hosted by InfoQ China from October 22 to 24, drew more than 1,200 attendees and 140 speakers from 70 companies, with the program centered on how AI moves from agent engineering into production delivery. In the opening keynote, Geekbang editor-in-chief Zhao Yuying argued that more agents isn't automatically better, since communication cost and error propagation grow, and that teams should focus on whether tasks finish and results can be verified.

items.title: 模型好选，搜索难做：一个投研Agent的两年开发历程
items.summary_zh: 写新能源产业链付费研报的陈万有约 4000 名订阅者，最近他删掉了自写的网页清洗脚本 cleaner.py 和列有 387 个网址的信源清单 sites.yaml，改用可独立接入 Agent 的搜索 API。测试中腾讯云元宝搜索除摘要外还返回正文段落与每条结果的发布时间；这类清洗与信源维护，是联网 Agent 绕不开的持续成本。
items.summary_en: Chen Wan writes a paid research brief on the energy-storage and lithium supply chain for roughly 4,000 subscribers. He recently deleted two files he had maintained for years: cleaner.py, which scraped web pages, and sites.yaml, a list of 387 vetted sources, replacing them with a search API that plugs directly into his agent. Tencent Cloud's Yuanbao search returned page summaries, question-relevant passages and per-result publish times rather than one-line abstracts.

items.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
items.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.
items.author: HKUDS
items.summary_zh: DeepTutor 是 HKUDS 在 GitHub 上开源的项目，定位为「终身个性化辅导」（Lifelong Personalized Tutoring），文档放在 deeptutor.info，另有一个合作入口页面。仓库首页目前主要是 logo 与徽章链接，具体实现和用法要进文档看，适合做教育类 Agent 的开发者先扫一眼。
items.summary_en: DeepTutor is an open-source GitHub project from HKUDS positioned as "Lifelong Personalized Tutoring," with documentation hosted at deeptutor.info and a separate page for collaborating with the team. The repository homepage is currently mostly logos and badge links, so implementation details and usage live in the docs. Worth a look for developers building education-oriented agents.

items.title: 中层技术经理要么重新学技术，要么考虑退休：前 Stripe 工程高管警告，未来三年工程管理将彻底变样
items.summary_zh: 前 Stripe、Uber 工程管理者、后任 Carta 与 Calm CTO 的 Will Larson 在 The Pragmatic Engineer 播客中判断，三年内传统工程管理岗位可能不复存在，中层技术经理要么重回技术一线，要么考虑退休。他自己从 Carta 管理约 250 人的组织转到 Imprint 带约 25 人团队，并认为既懂管理又能写代码的 TLM 会更抢手。
items.summary_en: Will Larson, who managed engineering at Stripe and Uber and later served as CTO at Carta and Calm, argues on The Pragmatic Engineer podcast that the traditional engineering-management role may disappear within three years, leaving mid-level managers to either get hands-on again or consider retiring. He made that move himself, going from a roughly 250-person org at Carta to a 25-person team at Imprint, and expects tech-lead-managers to be in demand.

items.title: Android Bench 2 新增对长周期任务、智能评估和连续评分的支持
items.summary_zh: 谷歌发布 Android Bench 2.0，新增长周期任务（LHT），覆盖升级依赖、添加功能、跨平台移植等工程师要花数天到一周的工作；评估从二元通过/失败改为按功能、视觉保真度和回归风险连续评分，并引入基于智能体的评估。目前 Claude Opus 5.5 以 32% 的 LHT 通过率居首，GPT 6 Astra 为 28%。
items.summary_en: Google released Android Bench 2.0, adding long-horizon tasks (LHT) such as dependency upgrades, new features, building apps from scratch and porting cross-platform apps, work that takes engineers days to a week. Scoring moved from binary pass/fail to a continuous completion rate weighing functionality, visual fidelity and regressions, plus agent-based evaluation. Claude Opus 5.5 currently leads with a 32% LHT pass rate, ahead of GPT 6 Astra at 28%.

items.title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
items.author: ltratt
items.summary_zh: 一篇主张“我们应当把软件做得更有野心”的文章，以 Michael Malis 用 Rust 重写的 Postgres 项目 pgrust 为例：外界对疑似 AI 生成的项目普遍怀疑，但 pgrust 的测试细致到挖出 Postgres 自身的多个真实 bug，涉及 SP-GiST 数值、JSONPath 格式缓存、pgcrypto 与 money 溢出。适合想厘清 AI 辅助开发质量边界的人阅读。
items.summary_en: An essay arguing that developers should be more ambitious about what they build, using pgrust — Michael Malis's Rust rewrite of Postgres — as the case in point. The author acknowledges the widespread skepticism toward AI-generated projects, then notes that pgrust's testing is thorough enough to have surfaced real Postgres bugs, including SP-GiST numeric errors, a JSONPath format cache bug, pgcrypto failures and a money overflow. Relevant to anyone judging where AI-assisted work actually holds up.

items.title: 富士康员工回应 iPhoneDuo 裂屏，称产能吃紧苹果曾降低良率质检标准，是真的吗？消费者能要求赔偿吗？
items.summary_zh: 知乎上的一则提问，围绕富士康员工对 iPhone Duo 屏幕开裂的回应展开：对方称产能吃紧期间，苹果曾放宽良率与质检标准。提问进一步追问这一说法是否属实，以及买到裂屏机器的消费者能否主张赔偿。原文是链接，未提供更多细节。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question about Foxconn employees' response to iPhone Duo screen-cracking complaints, in which they reportedly said Apple relaxed yield and quality-check standards while production capacity was tight. It goes on to ask whether that account holds up and whether buyers with cracked screens can claim compensation. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
items.author: pbakaus
items.summary_zh: impeccable 是给 AI 编码 agent 用的设计规范，含 1 个 skill、24 条命令、浏览器内实时迭代与 62 条确定性检测规则，用 npx impeccable install 安装、/impeccable init 接入。它从 Anthropic 的 frontend-design skill 起步，用 PRODUCT.md 固定产品定位，专门压制 Inter 字体、紫蓝渐变、卡片套卡片这类模板痕迹。适合用 AI 写前端又嫌页面千篇一律的开发者。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design guidance package for AI coding agents: one skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration and 62 deterministic detector rules, installed with npx impeccable install and initialized via /impeccable init. It builds on Anthropic's frontend-design skill and records product truth in PRODUCT.md to suppress the usual tells, such as Inter everywhere, purple-to-blue gradients and cards nested in cards. Useful for developers whose AI-written frontends all look alike.

items.title: makecindy/cindy
items.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
items.author: makecindy
items.summary_zh: Cindy 是 makecindy 团队以 Apache-2.0 开源的个人 AI Agent，主打开箱即用：把工作电脑、家用台式机、笔记本和手机连到一起，接入你现有的模型和订阅，让它在自己的机器上实际干活。它同时强调可改造，用户能按自己的工作习惯定制这个助手，适合想自托管 Agent 又不想从零搭框架的开发者。
items.summary_en: Cindy is an Apache-2.0 open-source AI agent from makecindy that is meant to work out of the box. It links your work computer, home desktop, laptop and phone, uses the models and subscriptions you already pay for, and does real work on your own machines. It's aimed at developers who want a customizable, self-hosted agent without building the scaffolding themselves.

items.title: 刚刚，GPT-6.1 Terra 骨折价发布，Agent 时代的打工模型来了
items.summary_zh: 36氪这篇报道称，GPT-6.1 Terra 以很低的折扣价发布，被定位为 Agent 时代承担日常执行工作的模型。标题把重点放在价格和 Agent 场景上，但原文只给出标题，具体的定价数字、能力指标和接入方式未提供更多细节。
items.summary_en: A 36kr report on the release of GPT-6.1 Terra, framed around a steeply discounted price and a role as the workhorse model for agent-era workloads. The headline emphasizes pricing and agent use rather than benchmark numbers. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title, including actual pricing, aren't available.

items.title: elayadesign/ai-design-skills
items.author: elayadesign
items.summary_zh: ai-design-skills 是 elayadesign 维护的设计技能集合，面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf 等会读取 markdown 规则文件的 AI 编程工具，每个技能是一个可独立安装的文件夹。目前提供 landing-page-design，涵盖页面结构、转化文案以及字体、间距、圆角、动效等视觉规范，适合希望 AI 按统一设计标准产出页面的开发者。
items.summary_en: ai-design-skills is a collection of design skills from elayadesign for AI coding tools that read markdown rule files, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Windsurf. Each skill is a self-contained folder you install individually; the first, landing-page-design, covers intake questions, page structure, conversion copy and a visual system of type, spacing, radius and motion. Useful if you want AI-generated pages to follow a consistent design standard.

items.title: Sebastian Raschka's from-scratch video course on building reasoning models
items.author: sgiannopoulos
items.summary_zh: Sebastian Raschka 发布了一套从零构建推理模型的视频课程，累计超过 11 小时的编码视频，内容覆盖评测、推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）、强化学习与蒸馏，代码使用 Python 和 PyTorch。适合想弄清推理模型训练全流程、而不满足于调用 API 的开发者。
items.summary_en: Sebastian Raschka has released a from-scratch video course on building reasoning models: more than 11 hours of coding footage covering evaluation, inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning and distillation, written in Python and PyTorch. It's aimed at developers who want to see how reasoning models are actually trained and evaluated, rather than just calling an API.

items.title: The Exponential Time Hypothesis Is False [pdf]
items.author: vok
items.summary_zh: Hacker News 上出现一篇 PDF 论文，标题直接宣称指数时间假设（ETH）不成立，随附内容只指向另一条宣布数学、计算机科学与物理三项新发现的帖子。ETH 是复杂性理论中许多下界结果的基础，一旦被推翻，相关结论都要重写。原文是 PDF 链接，此处未提供更多细节。
items.summary_en: A PDF paper posted to Hacker News argues that the Exponential Time Hypothesis is false; the only accompanying context is a link to another HN thread announcing three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics. ETH underpins many lower-bound results in complexity theory, so a refutation would force those results to be revisited. The linked PDF isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: 8点1氪丨Anthropic正式提交IPO申请；寿司郎传送带被曝窜出活老鼠；苹果客服称很多客户取消iPhone Duo订单
items.summary_zh: 36氪「8点1氪」汇总了三条消息：Anthropic 已正式提交 IPO 申请；寿司郎门店的传送带被曝有活老鼠窜出；苹果客服称许多客户取消了 iPhone Duo 订单。内容分别涉及 AI 公司的上市进程、连锁寿司的食品安全和苹果新机型的市场反馈。
items.summary_en: 36Kr's morning brief rounds up three stories: Anthropic has formally filed for an IPO, a live rat was reported emerging from a conveyor belt at a Sushiro restaurant, and Apple support staff say many customers are cancelling iPhone Duo orders. The items touch on AI-company financing, food safety at a conveyor-belt sushi chain, and early demand signals for a new Apple device.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail
items.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
items.author: JetBrains
items.summary_zh: ThinkRail 是 JetBrains 的孵化项目，一款 agentic IDE：它在 npm 包 @earendil-works/pi 提供的 pi 编码 agent 之上搭了完整界面，把任务隔离到独立 workspace，并用 living specs 与可复用 skills 让 agent 积累持久的项目知识。官方表示下一步将加入完整扩展支持，让它按你的实际工作方式生成所需工具。
items.summary_en: ThinkRail is a JetBrains incubator project: an agentic IDE built on the pi coding agent from the @earendil-works/pi npm package, wrapping it in a full interface, isolating each task in its own workspace, and giving the agent durable project knowledge through living specs and reusable skills. JetBrains says full extension support comes next, so the IDE can generate the tools it needs from how you actually work. It targets developers who want agents handling whole tasks rather than autocomplete.

items.title: US Government is hiding a secret court ruling about how it spies on Americans
items.author: helterskelter2
items.summary_zh: 两名美国参议员称，特朗普政府在推动国会续期美国覆盖面最广的监控项目的同时，扣留了一份 FISA 法院裁决不予公开，已属违法。争议在于立法者要在看不到法院如何裁定对美国人实施监控的情况下，先行投票决定是否延长该项目。
items.summary_en: Two US senators say the Trump administration is breaking the law by withholding a FISA court decision while pressing Congress to renew what the report calls America's most sweeping surveillance program. The clash matters because lawmakers are being asked to reauthorize the program without being able to see how the court has ruled on spying on Americans.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.author: affaan-m
items.summary_zh: ECC 是一个针对 AI coding agent 的 harness 性能优化系统，覆盖 skills、instincts、memory、security 与 research-first development 等模块，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等工具。它把 agent 的运行环境当作可调优的操作系统来对待，适合已经重度使用 coding agent、希望其行为更稳定可控的开发者。
items.summary_en: ECC is a performance optimization system for AI coding agent harnesses, adding skills, instincts, memory, security and research-first development on top of tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Opencode and Cursor. It treats an agent's runtime as a tunable operating system, which makes it relevant to developers who already lean on coding agents daily and want more stable, controllable behavior.

items.title: 如何看待网友发布的 30 系及 40 系显卡的 GPU 算力解锁工具 gpu-unlock？
items.summary_zh: 知乎上出现讨论，话题是网友发布的 gpu-unlock：一个针对 30 系和 40 系显卡的 GPU 算力解锁工具。“算力解锁”意味着改动显卡的官方性能限制，因此讨论自然围绕真实效果、稳定性与潜在风险展开；该问题帖未提供正文细节，具体实现方式和适用范围不明。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question asks what to make of gpu-unlock, a tool released by a user that claims to unlock GPU compute on 30-series and 40-series graphics cards. Unlocking compute touches vendor-imposed performance limits, so the practical questions are whether it works and what it risks. The post carries no body text here, so its implementation and supported cards aren't detailed.

items.title: gitroomhq/postiz-app
items.description: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖
items.author: gitroomhq
items.summary_zh: Postiz 是一个以 AGPL-3.0 发布的开源社交媒体管理平台，支持内容排期、自动化发布和数据效果分析，既可以注册官方托管的 Postiz Cloud，也可以部署在自己的服务器上，仓库内附有文档和 YouTube 教程。适合需要统一打理多个社交账号、又不想把账号数据交给第三方平台的团队自建使用。
items.summary_en: Postiz is an AGPL-3.0 licensed social media management platform for scheduling, automating and analyzing content. It comes in two forms: the managed Postiz Cloud, or a self-hosted open-source edition you deploy on your own infrastructure, with docs and YouTube tutorials linked from the repo. It targets teams that want one place to run multiple social accounts without handing data to a third party.

items.title: 基金经理重仓 AI 巨亏公开致歉，称没必要低位离场，等流动性恢复，当基金经理也靠信仰持股，算不算风险信号？
items.summary_zh: 这是知乎上的一个提问：一位基金经理因重仓 AI 出现较大亏损后公开致歉，并称没必要在低位离场，要等流动性恢复，提问者由此追问靠信仰持股本身算不算风险信号。原文是知乎问题页，未提供更多正文细节。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question about a fund manager who publicly apologized after heavy losses on concentrated AI positions, saying there is no reason to sell at the bottom and that he will wait for liquidity to return. The poster asks whether holding stocks on faith is itself a risk signal. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: 刚刚，Anthropic公开招股书：史上最大IPO，半年狂揽163亿美元
items.summary_zh: 据 36 氪报道，Anthropic 公开了招股书，被指为史上最大 IPO，半年内录得 163 亿美元。报道角度聚焦融资规模本身；原文只有标题，招股书的具体条款与业务数据未在素材中展开。
items.summary_en: 36Kr reports that Anthropic has released its IPO prospectus, described as the largest IPO on record, with $16.3 billion taken in over half a year. The report's angle is the scale of the listing itself. Only the headline figures are available here; the filing's terms and business detail are not covered in the source.

items.title: 刚刚，Anthropic公开335页招股书：史上最大IPO，史上最亏AI公司
items.summary_zh: 这是 36 氪对同一份 Anthropic 招股书的另一篇报道，强调文件长达 335 页，并把这家公司称为史上最亏的 AI 公司，与史上最大 IPO 的说法形成对照。原文为标题级信息，招股书中的具体财务与风险披露未在素材中给出。
items.summary_en: A second 36Kr piece on the same Anthropic filing leads with the document's length, 335 pages, and labels the company the biggest-loss AI company ever to list, set against the claim that this is the largest IPO in history. Only headline-level information is available; the filing's financial and risk disclosures are not covered in the source.

items.title: togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks
items.description: LIST OF ALL MY JAILBREAKS
items.author: togg53192-cmd
items.summary_zh: 这是 togg53192-cmd 的提示词仓库，收录 31 条面向 25 个以上模型的 system prompt、人格设定、workspace policy，以及 AGENTS.md 与 Ollama Modelfile 配置，对象包括 GLM、DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等。文件均为可直接粘贴的完整版本而非片段，适合研究提示词边界和红队测试的开发者。
items.summary_en: A repo from togg53192-cmd collecting 31 jailbreak-style prompts aimed at 25+ models, packaged as complete system prompts, persona definitions, workspace policies, AGENTS.md files and Ollama Modelfiles rather than partial excerpts. Targets span open-weight families such as GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen and Gemma alongside closed models including Claude, Gemini, Grok and Mistral. Useful for red-teaming and prompt-boundary research.

items.title: OpenAI 10 月 26 日宣布证明所有维度局部光滑猜想，一举推平调和分析四大猜想，如何理解这一事件？
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 于 10 月 26 日宣布证明了所有维度上的局部光滑猜想，并称由此推平调和分析领域的四大猜想。该猜想属于调和分析的核心难题，若证明成立，会影响这一方向上的基础结论。原帖只提供了问题标题，没有附带论文或更多技术细节。
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced on October 26 that it has proved the local smoothing conjecture in all dimensions, claiming the result settles four major conjectures in harmonic analysis. If it holds, it would be a foundational result for the field. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title, including any paper, aren't available.

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot
items.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
items.author: nightly-labs
items.summary_zh: OpenBot 是 nightly-labs 的本地优先桌面工作区，让 Codex、Claude 等 agent 各有独立工作区和对话，并内置任务队列、文件传输、内嵌浏览器与 agent 间的消息通信。它通过 ACP 还能接入 Grok CLI、Gemini 等，适合同时管理多个编程 agent 的开发者；但目前仍是开发预览版，agent 默认拥有完整访问权限且不询问审批，只适合运行可信任务。
items.summary_en: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace from nightly-labs that gives each AI agent its own workspace and conversation, plus task queues, file transfer, an embedded browser and agent-to-agent messaging. It runs the Codex App Server and Claude Code natively and adds Grok CLI, Gemini, Cursor CLI and others over ACP. It suits developers juggling several coding agents, but it's a dev preview where agents run with full access and no approval prompts.

items.title: 工资不发银行卡，改成数字人民币钱包，网友炸了...
items.summary_zh: 这条资讯讲的是把工资发放渠道从银行卡改为数字人民币钱包的做法，并引发网友热议。原文只有标题，没有提供正文，涉及哪家企业、发放范围多大、争议的具体焦点是什么，都无法确认。
items.summary_en: The story concerns salaries being paid into digital RMB wallets instead of bank cards, a change that drew a heated reaction online. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title, including which company is involved, how widely it applies and what exactly the complaints are about, aren't available.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文

items.summary_en: This post rounds up ten AI coding "Skills" that caught on in 2026, built on the Agent Skills standard Anthropic introduced in October 2025: each Skill is a folder with a SKILL.md that gets loaded from ~/.claude/skills/. The author says 70% of 100 community Skills failed testing, while the top pick, Superpowers, bundles 20+ submodules covering TDD, systematic debugging and code review. It's aimed at developers who want repeatable workflows instead of ad-hoc prompts.

items.summary_en: A long-time Codex user whose relay subscription got shut down spent a week on Tencent's agentic coding tool WorkBuddy and logged what it actually cost. With full-access permission it writes frontend and backend in one task, though UI fidelity still needs manual cleanup.

items.description: 一 前言 哈喽，大家好，我是 alien，今天我们来讲一个能够将精美网站一键复制的功能——ai-website-cloner-template 的使用和实现原理。 通过本篇文档你能收获到哪些内容？ A
items.summary_zh: 开发者 alien 介绍了 ai-website-cloner-template：本地 clone 模板后在 Claude Code 里执行 /clone-website，就能把任意网站复刻成代码。流程用 Playwright 在 1440×900、768×1024、390×844 三个视口截图，遍历 DOM 读取 getComputedStyle 提取 design tokens，并模拟滚动、点击、hover 抓取交互态。作者以掘金官网实测还原度约 70%，移动端适配较好。
items.summary_en: Developer alien walks through ai-website-cloner-template, a GitHub template you clone locally and drive from Claude Code via a /clone-website skill to rebuild any site as code. Tested against juejin.cn, the author measured roughly 70% UI fidelity, with mobile layouts holding up better.
